Thank you for your interest in supporting relations with the Kali tribe.
Of course. Tell me about it. If I can help, I'd like to...
strings.그러죠. 혹시 칼리 족에 대해서 아십니까?: Certainly. Do you know the Kali tribe?
The Kali are one of Eastland's many minority peoples.
strings.현재 칼리 족은 환영의 대지 어딘가에 있는 마을 '칼리'에 지내고 있습니: They currently live in the village of Kali, somewhere in the Land of Illusions.
strings.어딘가라면…. 정확히 어디에 있는지 모른다는 건가요?: Somewhere...? You don't know exactly where it is?
strings.맞습니다. 아마 강한 힘을 가지고 있거나 특별한 자만이 발견할 수 있다고: Correct. Apparently, only someone powerful or exceptional can find it. Someone like Shynic might locate it easily.
strings.잠깐…, 그 정도면 그곳에 샤이닉 님 정도의 힘을 가진 사람이 있다는 건: Wait... Does that mean someone as strong as Shynic lives there? It sounds like they've set up something to keep people out...
strings.맞습니다. 이해가 빠르시군요. 칼리 족의 지도자 메디아 님께서 초인 중: Exactly. You catch on quickly. The Kali tribe's leader, Medea, is a Champion.
I'd like to meet her soon.
Shynic has entrusted all relations with the other Champions to me.
strings.보나 마나 재미도 없고 귀찮아서 그런 거 아닌가요?: Because she finds it boring and bothersome, obviously?
strings.데이모스 암흑 성국에서 마음 먹고 저희 도시를 노린다면 쥬드 왕국을 비롯: If the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos seriously targets our city, Jude and even Lumen will be in danger.
That's why we want to maintain the closest possible ties with the Champions.
strings.지스카드 님이 계신 루맨과는 어느 정도 협력을 하고 있지만, 공통의 적인: We cooperate to some extent with Lumen, where Ziskad lives. But apart from our common enemy, Weiss, relations with the others are rather distant.
strings.환영의 대지의 아드키나 님께선 용의 계곡에 계시지만 일반 인간이 들어갈: Lord Atkina lives in Dragon Valley in the Land of Illusions, but ordinary humans can't enter.
strings.게다가 눈보라 여제께서는 너무 멀리 계시고…. 흉왕은 말이 안 통하는 사: And the Blizzard Empress is too far away... while the Fierce King can't be reasoned with...
So you're approaching the nearest Champion with the best chance of cooperation.
strings.아무래도 그러는 게 제일 좋을 것 같습니다. 긍정적으로 생각하는 이유 중: That seems wisest. One reason for optimism is that Shynic apparently had dealings with the Kali tribe in the past.
strings.교류하지 않은지 벌써 오래…. 일단 교류를 재개하려면 외지의 물건을 구해: It's been a long time since then... Noel suggests bringing goods from outside as a first step toward renewing relations.
strings.누구보다 교류를 원하는 사람이 칼리 족인 노엘이기도 하니까요. 가서 이야: Noel is Kali herself, and more eager than anyone to renew those ties. Please go hear what she has to say.
strings.그럼 부탁드립니다. 어쩌면 이 일…, 모험가님께서 모시는 신을 위한 일이: I'm counting on you. This may even serve the god you follow, adventurer.
strings.일단 노엘하고 이야기해볼게요. 다녀오겠습니다. 그리고 샤이닉 님께 저에: I'll talk to Noel. And please put in a good word for me with Shynic.
You needn't worry about that. Hehe.
What a wonderful adventurer! Won't you buy something?
strings.…제가 좀 멋지긴 하지만…. 너무 영업용 스마일 아닌가요?: ...I am rather wonderful, but isn't that smile a little too obviously for sales?
strings.먹고 살려면 어쩔 수 없죠. 안 사실 거면 나중에 오세요. 멋지긴 하나도: I have to make a living. If you're not buying, come back later. Not so wonderful after all...
strings.너무 야박한 거 아닌가요? 아, 제가 노엘 씨 보러 온 건 멜빅 씨가 가: Isn't that a bit harsh? Anyway, Melvic told me to come see you...
strings.네? 멜빅 씨가요? 그 잘생긴 멜빅 씨가요? 저에 대해서 무슨 말씀하셨나: What? Melvic? The handsome Melvic? What did he say about me?
Your attitude changed fast when I mentioned him.
strings.헛, 제가 그랬나요? 죄송해요. 말씀하세요. 멜빅 씨가 보내서 오신 거라: Oh! Did it? I'm sorry. Go on. If he sent you, I'll do a-anything!
strings.(멜빅과 했던 이야기를 노엘에게 들려준다.): (You tell Noel about your conversation with Melvic.)
strings.헛, 진짜요? 그 물건들을 구해주신다구요? 그동안 선뜻 나서서 구해준다는: Oh! Really? You'll get those goods? No one's ever volunteered to fetch them before...
So you want something from our Kali tribe, too.
Nothing underhanded. There's something I need to do.
strings.(어떤 일로 타르타로스로 오게 됐는지, 칼리 족 교류 지원을 어떤 의도로: (You explain what brought you to Tartaros and why you are helping establish relations with the Kali tribe.)
strings.네, 이해했어요. 적어도 나쁜 일로 칼리 족을 이용하는 게 아닌 걸 알게: I understand. At least I know you aren't using my people for something bad. Then I'll tell you what we need.
strings.감사합니다. 마을 사람들이랑 싸우고 뛰쳐나와 면목 없긴 하지만, 도움이: Thank you. I fought with the villagers and ran away, so I'm ashamed... But I still want to help.
strings.저도 도움이 될게요. 약속할게요. 그러니 제 눈 앞에 팔려고 내놓은 물건: I'll help, too. I promise. So could you put away the merchandise you're waving in front of me?
I'll buy plenty another time. For now, I'll fetch those supplies.
strings.아, 맞다. 물건들 구하시면 레이어 님에게 가져다주세요. 창고에 보관 잘: Oh, right. Once you have them, bring them to Layer. He'll keep them safely in the warehouse. And...
Please put in a good word with Melvic. Tell him Noel took great care explaining everything.
Thank you for thinking of my people. Please be careful.
Noel told me. You've brought goods to establish ties with the Kali tribe.
I'll keep them safely in storage and hand them to Melvic when the time comes.
strings.그러고 보니 오래전 칼리 족의 메디아 님을 만난 적이 있는데, 마침 그: It reminds me of meeting Medea of the Kali tribe long ago.
I'm curious about her. I think I'll need to meet her someday...
strings.정보가 될지 모르겠는데, 간단하게 이야기 들어보겠어?: I don't know how useful it will be, but would you like to hear the story?
strings.젊은 날, 나는 돈 되는 일이라면 닥치는 대로 했던 용병이었지. 부끄럽지: In my youth, I was a mercenary who took any job that paid. I'm embarrassed to say I even had the cheesy title 'Beast of the Desert.'
strings.일을 끝내고 혼자 쥬드 왕국으로 돌아가던 중이었는데, 그만 정신이 흐릿해: I was returning alone to Jude after a job when I became faint and collapsed. It must have been the Land of Illusions near Tartaros.
I knew nothing about the place. Lying there, I thought I would die...
strings.다행히 눈을 떠보니 동물 귀를 가진 사람들이 사는 신비한 마을이었어. 바: Fortunately, I woke in a mysterious village of people with animal ears. That was Kali.
strings.그곳의 지도자 메디아 님의 도움으로 금방 회복할 수 있었고, 빠르게 쥬드: With their leader Medea's help, I recovered quickly and soon returned to Jude.
strings.정말 신기하단 말이지. 많은 회복 마법을 경험했지만, 그분의 힘 만큼 순: It was extraordinary. I'd experienced plenty of healing magic, but never anything as pure, clear, and powerful as hers...
I wondered if she was a goddess incarnate.
strings.역시 초인이니까 그 정도로 강한 힘을 가지고 있는 게 아닐까요?: Maybe she's that powerful because she's a Champion?
Perhaps...? That was thirty years ago now.
strings.자기 말이야. 교류를 위해 일을 하는 거면 한 가지 물건 더 구해다 주지: Since you're working to build relations, could you bring one more thing?
strings.한 권의 책이야. 메디아 님이 책을 좋아하시는데, 워낙 외진 마을이라 그: A book. Medea loves books, but in such a remote village, some are impossible to find. She was disappointed about one in particular.
strings.자기가 구해온 물건에 메디아 님이 찾던 책을 가져다주면 좀 더 좋지 않을: If you added the book she wanted to the supplies you've brought, it might help...
strings.어떤 누군가의 기억을 담은 책이라 하더군. 잘은 모르지만, 먼 대륙의 공: One containing someone's memories, she said. I don't know the details, but a princess on a distant continent paid to have it made and distributed free...
strings.그 책을 구해서 읽고 있는 메디아 님을 떠올리니 기뻐. 찾아보고 그 책이: It makes me happy to imagine Medea finally reading it. If you find it, bring it to me.
strings.일단 확실하지 않으니 그 책의 주인부터 확인할게요. 가져오는 건 그 다음: I'm not certain yet, so I'll check with the person who has it first. Bringing it back comes after... I'll return with good news soon. Just wait!
strings.우왕, 모험가 님! 헤르네가 많이 보고 싶었어요!: Wow, adventurer! Herne missed you so much!
strings.그동안 어떤 모험을 하셨어요? 들려주세요!: What adventures have you had? Tell me!
strings.동방 대륙도 가고, 천공의 대륙도 갔다고 들었어요!: I heard you went to the Eastern Continent and the continent in the sky!
Herne, slow down. You'll run out of breath.
strings.헤헤, 죄송해요. 그런데 헤르네에겐 무슨 일로 오셨어요?: Hehe, sorry. What brings you to see Herne?
strings.(다른 대륙의 어떤 마을과 도시 간의 교류를 위해 어떤 책이 필요하다고: (You explain that you need a book to help establish relations between a village and a city on another continent.)
A book a princess on a distant continent paid to publish and give away... Hmm...
strings.이리스 언니의 이야기를 담은 책, 아직 많아요. 그분에게 꼭 가져다주세요: The book about big sister Iris. We still have plenty. Please take one to her.
strings.왕녀님이 좋아할 만한 이야기가 뭐가 있을까요. 그러면 동방 대륙에 있는: What story would you enjoy? How about the Champions of the Eastern Continent?
strings.(그동안 있었던 일을 간단하게 헤르네에게 이야기한다.): (You briefly tell Herne about your recent adventures.)
strings.어른이 되면 저도 모험가님처럼 그런 모험을 해보고 싶어요!: When I grow up, I want to have adventures like yours!
strings.(헤종이 심기가 불편했는지 자꾸 헛기침한다. 그리고 %s의 얼굴을 빤히: (Hejong keeps clearing his throat, apparently displeased, and stares at %s.)
strings.(쿨럭, 내가 괜한 이야기를 했나….): (Ahem. Perhaps I shouldn't have told her that...)
strings.헤르네가 자꾸 바깥 세상에 관심을 두는 것 같아 신경이 쓰인다네. 자네의: Herne's growing interest in the outside world worries me. Your stories aren't bad, but I can't help feeling anxious.
strings.모험가님, 더 이야기해주시면 안 돼요? 이리스 언니 이야기도 해주세요!: Adventurer, can't you tell me more? Tell me about big sister Iris, too!
strings.허허, 헤르네. 모험가는 바쁘단다. 오늘이 아니면 나중에 이야기를 듣자꾸: Now, Herne. The adventurer is busy. If not today, we can hear more another time.
strings.왕녀님, 죄송해요. 제가 할 일이 있어서…. 폐하, 그럼 나중에 뵙겠습니: I'm sorry, Princess. I have work to do... Until next time, Your Majesty. Farewell, Princess.
strings.히잉…. 어쩔 수 없죠. 그래도 나중에 헤르네 보러 또 오세요! 꼭이에요: Aww... I suppose it can't be helped. But come see Herne again! Promise!
You're back, so you must have found the book.
Yes. It was easier than I expected.
strings.신기한 책이군…. 아련한 기억이 담겨 있는 책…. 그런데 이리스라는 이름: A remarkable book... Full of wistful memories... But I've heard the name Iris somewhere...
strings.마왕을 쓰러뜨리고, 세레스 여신의 뒤를 이어 이 세계의 신이 된 소녀의: She's the girl who defeated the Demon King and succeeded Goddess Seres as this world's god.
strings.사실 나는 누가 신이든 상관없었어. 그냥 나 하나만 믿고 살아온 게 전부: Truthfully, I never cared who the god was. I've lived trusting only myself.
strings.누구나 기구한 사연 하나씩은 있겠지만, 이리스 여신님은 뭔가 더 슬픈 사: Everyone has a troubled story, but I feel Goddess Iris's must be sadder than most.
I wonder why Medea wanted this book.
strings.나중에 만나면 알 수 있지 않을까요?: You could ask when you meet her again.
Again... It's lonely, not knowing when that might be.
strings.쓸데없는 이야기는 그만하고. 자기 덕분에 심심하진 않았어. 덕분에 즐거웠: Enough of that idle talk. You kept me from being bored. I've enjoyed this.
If I go to Kali, I'll give Medea your regards.
strings.그래. 고마워. 자기는 워낙 특별한 사람이니까, 칼리에도 갈 수 있을 거: Thank you. You're a special person. I'm sure you'll reach Kali and meet her.
strings.나중에 내 도움이 필요하다면 언제라도 찾아와. 자기라면 언제나 도와줄 수: If you ever need my help, come anytime. For you, I'll always lend a hand. Good luck.
